s4.title: 125 NUTRONs | Behind the Bumpers | FRC REBUILT Robot

s5.title: Tips to Win the Championship | FRC FUNalysis

bet.text: Go big on the dye rotor: a larger dish for more balls per second, with the drivetrain shaped around it.

demand.text: The team compared a turret and a dumper and chose a turret to shoot on the move, shoot while defended and pick up while shooting. It wanted to adapt to its teammates and opponents.

auto.text: A chooser builds each auto: left or right start, bump or trench on the second path, and how far to go along the midline, to suit partners or to beat the other team to midfield. Custom acceleration limits allow for the robot filling up.

cycle.text: A drum-roller intake fills a hopper mounted on the bumpers. Fuel drops into the dye rotor, which feeds a turreted shooter that can shoot on the move at the hub or while feeding from the opposite side. Shooting starts about two seconds before the hub turns on.

changed.text: A dual-roller intake jammed a lot; it became one shaft with wheels of about 3 in, then a drum roller for championships. Two shooter motors were not enough for corner shots or very far feeding, so a third was added.
A commentator on a New England division match says comms problems put 125 out of it at times.

outcome.text: 68-17-1 in official play; ranked 13 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 310.32, Curie).

solves.text: Fit a larger dye rotor dish and a wider front intake in one frame

facts.text: The dish size dictated the drivetrain shape
Wider at the front for a bigger intake and smaller at the rear, because most balls do not reach the back
Side plate thickness, about; 2 by 1 tube is used only for the main structure in the middle
Two stock WCP X2S swerve modules at the front; two custom-machined X2S modules at the rear, shaped for the wider angle and the dish radius

solves.text: Keep continuous contact with the ball, with fewer dead spots and fewer jams than two rollers

facts.text: The roller is a live-shaft drum of carbon fiber tube wrapped in silicone; tube size about
A kick bar with three standoffs keeps compression along the ball path
A stiffener bar lets the driver run into things without breaking the intake
Removing two shoulder bolts on each side takes the whole intake off
A piece is cut out of the intake so the robot can sit under a field element (caption unclear) at the start of auto
The hopper is mounted on the bumpers and drops fuel into the dye rotor

solves.text: Raise the number of balls fed per second

facts.text: Dish size, against eight or nine balls normally, about
One motor through a 90 degree gearbox spins the hook; a central motor up through the middle drives the feed rollers
Double-stacked wheels at the front and two sets of vertical rollers, front and back, clear the dead zone in the middle where one ball would stick

solves.text: Aim on the move, while defended and while picking up; the team says it was the only way to use a dye rotor

facts.text: One X44 at the back drives it by belt, pinion, idler and main turret gear
A second encoder gives absolute position, which makes zeroing at the start of a match easier

solves.text: Reach corner shots and far feeding, which two motors could not do

facts.text: Three X44 motors geared one to one to a front wheel of about this size
A roller of about 1 in at the top reduces backspin, and feed wheels bring the ball up to speed
The hooded shooter ducks to pass under the trench

solves.text: Understand and control easily what the robot does

facts.text: Everything the robot should do sits in one class mapped to triggers, so autonomous and teleop use the same commands
The aim target depends on which field region the pose is in, and field data says whether the robot may shoot
Two interpolation tables set hood angle and shooter speed; a time-of-flight model adds chassis speed to the target

decisions.because: the team wanted to shoot on the move, shoot while defended and pick up while shooting
it helps raise balls per second

decisions.choice: One drum roller in the intake
decisions.because: two rollers caused a lot of jamming and the drum has fewer dead spots than wheels
decisions.instead_of: two rollers, then one shaft of wheels

decisions.because: two motors were not enough for corner shots and very far feeding
with the added motor the team had the current and power for it
decisions.instead_of: shots as flat as possible, chosen first so shooter speed errors would not cost accuracy
